name: Mend
description: Cast Mend at Level 4 for 20 Mana. Fae light restores HP after the next three surviving enemy responses.

healingTiers.narration: A few tiny wisps of Fae light gather around your wounds and begin patching you up. There aren't many of them, but they seem very determined.
Soft Fae light wraps around you as tiny glowing leaves settle over your wounds. They seem comfortable there. Apparently they're staying awhile.
A swirl of Fae light rushes around you as glowing leaves begin carefully mending your wounds. One gives you a reassuring little pat. You're not sure how a leaf did that.

Fae light bursts around you as a tiny garden of glowing leaves springs to life, immediately getting to work on your wounds. One leaf appears to be supervising the others. It is taking this responsibility extremely seriously.

criticalFlavor: The supervising leaf silently judges your injuries. Somehow, you feel responsible for them.
Two of the leaves begin arguing over the same wound. Healing continues despite workplace tensions.
One leaf finishes early and starts following you around. Apparently you've been assigned emotional support foliage.
A tiny leaf gives you another reassuring pat. Okay. They can definitely do that.
The supervising leaf turns toward the enemy. You have never seen a leaf look this disappointed.
